generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An open or extensible semantic decision is placed behind a finite precondition, so unseen precondition values can short-circuit before the transferable discriminator runs.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Generalize downstream members and holdouts while retaining a finite outer key, prefix, head or type switch whose miss returns a default result before the open-class decision.
trigger_signals: finite precondition before the main discriminator
early return on unknown gate values
withheld tests vary only downstream fields
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: For every open-class boundary, enumerate finite preconditions and execute withheld values outside each gate, including at least two sibling gate dimensions plus an opposite-class abstention control.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Inspect early returns, finite keys, heads, prefixes, type switches and allowlists before an open-class decision; independently vary the gate itself, not only fields after it, at the real boundary.

transfer_cases.surface: extensible parser classification behind a finite record-kind prefix
transfer_cases.evidence: generic prevention contract test requires withheld gate values

transfer_cases.surface: extensible routing decision behind a finite adapter/type switch
transfer_cases.evidence: generic detection contract test requires independent gate variation
